"society centric" and not "Judge centric" that is, whether the society will approve the awarding of
death sentence to certain types of crimes or not. Coming to the question as to whether the sentences awarded for the other offences upon the said
accused-appellants, shall run concurrently or consecutively, in Vikas Yadav Vs. The larger Bench was dealing with the following question:-
"Whether consecutive life sentences can be awarded to a convict on being found
